column1: # The animals of the player's active mods whose grown ones have a call of their own (RimWorld 1.7, the uploaded defs,
# 7 November 2026): what PokeWorldSoundsMath.Voices may name besides the base game. Real animals only (no mechanoids,
# dryads, summoned constructs or undead). The many others call with the base game's sounds again and are left out.
